review_evidence: README describes type-safe CBOR/JSON/String serialization, deriving support, Lean meta-type serialization, and experimental elaboration-state snapshots.
The 23 primary Lean files implement serializers, container/primitive/meta/time/snapshot adapters, deriving machinery, executable entry points, and tests.
A declaration scan finds no theorem, lemma, example, or axiom declarations; the repository provides software interfaces and roundtrip tests but no independent formal semantics/proof development.
